class.name: CgamePlatformServices
class.brief_description: Engine singleton that abstracts the host platform for game code.

method.name: attach_to_scene_tree
method.description: Adds a helper node to the scene tree root that forwards application pause and resume notifications to this object. Does nothing if the scene tree does not exist yet or the helper is already attached. The singleton calls this automatically.

method.name: can_use_chat
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if chat is not restricted and the network is available.

method.name: can_use_online
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if online play is not restricted and the network is available.

method.name: decode_save
method.description: Decodes bytes produced by [method encode_save]. Returns an empty dictionary if the data is empty, truncated, has a wrong magic or a wrong hash, or is not a JSON object.

method.name: encode_save
method.description: Wraps [param data] in the integrity envelope [code]CGS1:<hash>:<json>[/code].

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns the active backend, creating a [CgameDesktopPlatformBackend] if none was set.

method.name: get_last_recover_source
method.description: Returns the [enum RecoverSource] of the most recent [method load_game] call.

method.name: get_last_session_end_reason
method.description: Returns the reason of the last [signal session_ended], for example [code]"signed_out:user1"[/code].

method.name: handle_notification
method.description: Handles a main-loop notification. [constant MainLoop.NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_PAUSED] suspends the backend and [constant MainLoop.NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_RESUMED] resumes it. Other values are ignored.

method.name: has_entitlement
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the backend granted the entitlement [param id].

method.name: is_paused_for_controller
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the session's controller is disconnected.

method.name: is_paused_for_suspend
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the application is suspended.

method.name: is_session_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a signed-in session is running.

method.name: load_game
method.description: Loads [param slot]. Returns [code]{"result": SaveResult, "data": Dictionary, "source": RecoverSource}[/code]. [constant SAVE_NO_USER] and [constant SAVE_SUSPENDED] are returned without touching storage. If the main file does not validate, the backup copy is tried. [constant SAVE_NOT_FOUND] means both copies are missing, [constant SAVE_CORRUPT] that at least one exists but none validates.

method.name: network_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the backend reports a network connection.

method.name: request_text
method.description: Requests text through the platform keyboard. Returns [code]{"ok": bool, "text": String}[/code]. When [code]ok[/code] is [code]false[/code] the UI should show its own keyboard.

method.name: save_game
method.description: Saves [param data] to [param slot] and returns a [enum SaveResult]. Returns [constant SAVE_NO_USER] if nobody is signed in and [constant SAVE_SUSPENDED] while suspended.

method.name: set_backend
method.description: Replaces the backend and reconnects the lifecycle signals. [member is_session_active] is derived from the new backend's sign-in state.

method.name: set_presence
method.description: Sets the presence (rich status) text on the backend.

method.name: should_pause
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the game should be paused because the controller was lost or the application is suspended.

method.name: start_session
method.description: Starts a session owned by the controller [param device_id]. Returns [code]false[/code] if nobody is signed in. The session starts paused if the controller is not connected.

method.name: unlock_achievement
method.description: Unlocks the achievement [param id] and emits [signal achievement_unlocked] if it was new. Returns whether it was new.

signal.name: session_ended
signal.description: Emitted when the session ended, for example because the user signed out. [param reason] has the form [code]"signed_out:<user id>"[/code].

signal.name: pause_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a pause cause changed. [param paused] is the combined result of [method should_pause]; [param reason] is one of [code]"controller_disconnected"[/code], [code]"controller_reconnected"[/code], [code]"suspend"[/code] or [code]"resume"[/code].

signal.name: achievement_unlocked
signal.description: Emitted when [param id] was newly unlocked.
